Evan (Platform): QuantumCloud invoice INV-55321 for $12,860 failed matching — vendor lists PO Q-2025-77. Can procurement route?
Aisha - Procurement: That PO format looks legacy. @QuantumCloud Billing can you attach invoice PDF and itemized lines?
QuantumCloud Billing: Attached link: https://quantum.example/inv/INV-55321. PO shows Q-2025-77 (legacy). Item lines: base $10,000; overages $2,300; tax $560. We can reissue.
Ravi (Finance): Without a live PO we can't auto-approve. We can do provisional up to $9k with CFO signoff. Need GL and cost center.
Evan (Platform): GL 5403, cost center INF-PLAT. Overages are for spot GPUs — Nina can confirm usage.
Nina (SRE): Confirmed usage telemetry: matches base and 18 overage hours, not 30. Looks like vendor billed extra hours.
POBot: Legacy PO check: Q-2025-77 -> FOUND as PO_LEG_Q77, status CLOSED, owner Aisha. Recommend reopening as PO-2026-402.
Aisha - Procurement: I'll create PO-2026-402 and link legacy ref. QuantumCloud please resend invoice with PO-2026-402.
QuantumCloud Billing: Will reissue within 48 hours with corrected hours and PO.
Samir (CFO): I approve provisional payment up to $9,000. Hold remainder until corrected invoice and PO. Finance, add memo "provisional - legacy PO reconcile".
Ravi (Finance): Will queue provisional payment and mark $3,860 on hold pending corrected invoice and dispute resolution if billing doesn't match telemetry.
Evan (Platform): Thanks — reopening if vendor resends incorrect invoice.
